dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, interlocking 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored patterns are visible across the mid-dorsal region. The perimeters are jagged (crenulated) with a high-contrast gradient transition from the dark-brown exterior to a lighter, speckled interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters is concentrated on the distal regions of the hind flippers and the posterior-most dorsal surface. These clusters are solid in intensity and lack internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli in the upper-mid dorsal region form an obtuse-angled triangle, while the relative positions of the high-intensity blobs on the flipper digits form a roughly linear geometric arrangement.
